intent.goal: Install and run Sherlock natively on Windows with no WSL requirement while preserving Unix collection and telemetry durability.
must_happen: PowerShell 5.1 installation/reinstallation preserves installation identity and queued telemetry.
Installed Codex and Claude hooks execute native commands and launch durable background capture/drain.
Real subprocess locks exclude competing collectors and recover after terminated owners.
Run Windows CI and distinguish provider-interface fixtures from authenticated provider sessions.
must_not_happen: Never mutate source telemetry or database facts.
Never weaken Unix owner-only permissions or trust unrelated hooks.
Do not merge or deploy without authorization.
constraints: Python >=3.11; shared collector logic with a small platform layer.
Preserve existing macOS/Linux installation and hook behavior.
open_questions: Actual Windows provider CLI availability and hook execution compatibility.
Windows filesystem ACL, open-handle replacement and detached process behavior.
assumptions: Current official Codex commandWindows and Claude exec-form hook APIs can be capability-checked and tested.

proof_obligations.claim: Collector imports and CLI startup work on native Windows.
proof_obligations.verification: Windows CI imports and CLI smoke.

proof_obligations.claim: Real process locks exclude competitors and recover after owner death.
proof_obligations.verification: Subprocess contention and terminated-owner recovery on Windows and Unix.

proof_obligations.claim: Atomic state/spool writes and reinstall retain valid durable files with Windows open-handle semantics.
Append/replacement generation identity captures bytes without gaps.
proof_obligations.verification: Generation tests including unavailable/reused inode and same-size replacement.

proof_obligations.claim: Crash recovery preserves exact source bytes and durable queue.
proof_obligations.verification: Capture/drain recovery tests and immutable source byte assertions.

proof_obligations.claim: Detached drain survives the hook parent.
proof_obligations.verification: Real hook exits and local HTTP endpoint observes eventual upload.

proof_obligations.claim: PowerShell 5.1 installs and reinstalls preserving identity and queues.
proof_obligations.verification: Native Windows installation tests from paths with spaces and invalid identity preflight.

proof_obligations.claim: Exact installed native provider hook commands execute correctly.
proof_obligations.verification: Native manifest command execution and official provider capability checks.

proof_obligations.claim: Codex app-server pipe transport and trust verification work portably.
proof_obligations.verification: Real subprocess JSON protocol, timeout/EOF tests and trust boundary rejection.

proof_obligations.claim: Existing macOS/Linux collector and installer behavior remains intact.
proof_obligations.verification: Full collector suite on Unix; source-only diff and independent adversarial review.
